# API Service

This directory contains the source code for our main API service. It is a very important part of our system.

## Overview

The API service is responsible for handling all incoming HTTP requests from clients.

## Building

To build the project, you should run the following command in your terminal:

    npm run build

This will compile all of the TypeScript files into JavaScript.

We use Vitest for testing. Run the tests like so:

    npm run test
